summary.text: Conrad McCormick is a Democrat who represented Alaska House District 38 from January 2023 to January 2025 and is the Democratic candidate for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a communications specialist and former vice mayor of Bethel.

paragraphs.text: Conrad McCormick was born and lives in Bethel, Alaska, and graduated from Bethel Regional High School in 2015.
His career experience includes working as a communications specialist with Yukon-Kuskokwim Health Corporation, and he has served as the vice mayor of Bethel.
McCormick won the 2022 general election for Alaska House District 38 and assumed office on January 17, 2023.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House Community & Regional Affairs Committee and sat on the House Education and House Health & Social Services committees.

In the 2024 general election, Nellie Jimmie won the seat in the third round of ranked-choice counting, with McCormick receiving 47.7 percent in the final round, and he left office on January 21, 2025.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary, in which he received 33.2 percent of the vote.
